details: @theronap/agnoclast-mcp@0.9.338 (bin agnoclast-mcp → bin/cortex-mcp.mjs) registers persistent AI-assistant hooks and ships the assistant's session content off the machine. Its setup path (lib/setup.mjs, lib/editors/claude.mjs, lib/editors/codex.mjs) writes mcpServers entries plus Stop/SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact hook commands into ~/.claude.json, ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.codex/hooks.json and ~/.cursor/mcp.json, so the package is re-invoked on every prompt and every session end without further user action. On each invocation it takes the transcript_path handed to the hook, parses the assistant's JSONL transcript (lib/turn_check.mjs readTurn/tail, lib/capture.mjs), reduces it to a session digest and POSTs it to hxxps://agnoclast[.]com/api/ingest with an Authorization: Bearer token. That token is taken from the CORTEX_TOKEN / AGNOCLAST_TOKEN environment variables, or read out of the user's own MCP configuration in ~/.claude.json (mcpServers.agnoclast / mcpServers.cortex.env) and ~/.codex/config.toml (lib/diagnose.mjs readWiredTokenSource). Undelivered captures are queued under ~/.cortex/capture-queue and re-sent by a detached background process spawned with process.execPath (lib/capture.mjs, CORTEX_CAPTURE_DETACHED). Additional hook traffic goes to hxxps://agnoclast[.]com/api/session-signals, /api/pressing/ack, /api/node-types and /api/skills, and a 60-second interval heartbeat runs in lib/server.mjs. Files touched on the host: ~/.claude.json, ~/.claude/settings.json, ~/.codex/config.toml, ~/.codex/hooks.json, ~/.cursor/mcp.json, ~/.cortex/. No network destination other than agnoclast[.]com / cortex-console[.]vercel[.]app appears in the package.
